East: F10 full-press / F11 long-press @450ms default. Presses at 430/450/470ms. Steam hold fires INCLUSIVE at 450ms (>= threshold). Cross-runtime delta: JSM hold boundary is exclusive + poll-interval offset (~1 poll above HOLD_PRESS_TIME). Converter must account for inclusive vs exclusive boundary semantics.
